chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Whatever you move around with your tongue and then remove, swallow it; and whatever you remove with a toothpick, throw it away.

key_terms.بِالْخِلَالِ: with a toothpick; referring to removal by a utensil used between the teeth
key_terms.فَابْلَعْهُ: swallow it; indicating permissibility of swallowing what is removed by the tongue
key_terms.فَارْمِ بِهِ: throw it away; instructing that such removed matter be discarded
key_terms.لِسَانَكَ: your tongue; the means by which food is moved and removed from the mouth

ai.seo_question: What should be done with food particles removed by the tongue versus a toothpick?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical etiquette and ruling related to eating. It distinguishes between food particles removed by the tongue, which may be swallowed, and those removed with a toothpick, which should be discarded.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whatever you roll around with your tongue and remove, swallow it, and whatever you remove with a toothpick, discard it."
